name: draingap-marketplace
description: Marketplace for draingap, which checks that a Go HTTP service drains its requests before Kubernetes kills it.

plugins.name: draingap
plugins.description: Find why a Go service drops requests during Kubernetes deploys: SIGTERM not handled, Shutdown with a canceled context, main exiting while Shutdown drains, and preStop plus Shutdown deadlines longer than terminationGracePeriodSeconds.
